7thHeaven.se: 7th Heaven · Lost Souls
Eric decides to quit the ministry and Lucy catches Kevin dancing with Roxanne.
7th Heaven · A Cry for Help
Eric helps a suicidal teen while working at a college radio station; Roxanne and Lucy finally call a truce; Ruthie learns how to dump a boy.
7th Heaven · Sunday
Simon and Cecilia seek their parents’ permission to have sex; Lucy struggles with Roxanne and Chandler’s blossoming relationship.
7th Heaven · Back in the Saddle
Ruthie befriends a girl withm cystic fibrosis; Cecilia gives Simon the cold shoulder; Eric agrees to see a therapist to appease Annie.
7th Heaven · It's Not Always About You
Lucy tries to get out of jury duty and Annie attends therapy with Eric.
7th Heaven · Smoking
Chandler’s rebellious twin, Sid (Jason London guest stars), comes to town; Annie suspects that Simon is smoking.
7th Heaven · I Love Lucy
Kevin proposes to Lucy on Valentine’s Day; Chandler considers popping the question to Roxanne.
7th Heaven · Stand Up
Annie infringes on Lucy's wedding plans; Simon is accused of stealing from work.
7th Heaven · High Anxiety
Lucy quits school to plan her wedding; Eric and Annie fear that their friends are headed for a divorce.
7th Heaven · We Do
A major storm threatens to postpone Lucy’s wedding; Mary and Matt show up just in the nick of time.
7th Heaven · That Touch of Bink, Part 1
Lucy divulges intimate details about her honeymoon to Roxanne; Peter has reservations about his mother’s new boyfriend.
7th Heaven · Dick, Part 2
Kevin helps uncover the criminal past of Paris’ new fiancée; Chandler counsels a con-artist (Mayim Bialik guest stars).
7th Heaven · Life and Death, Part 1
Matt and Sarah suspect she may be pregnant; Eric visits Chandler’s father in New York; Lucy’s peculiar classmate falls for Simon.
7th Heaven · Life and Death, Part 2
Lucy fears that she is pregnant; Chandler and his father reconcile; Mary returns to Glenoak to tell Lucy that she got married.
7th Heaven · The Long Bad Summer, Part 1
It's the last day of the Camdens' summer vacation. Simon is haunted by memories of a fatal car accident.
7th Heaven · An Early Fall, Part 2
Mary returns home with some surprising news for Mary and her parents.
7th Heaven · PK (Preacher's Kid)
Annie leaves town, Peter defends Ruthie, and Simon plans for the future.
7th Heaven · I Wasn't Expecting That!
A new neighbor helps several Camdens – and their friends – in distress.
